# Matthew McCluster / McCluster Corp

> A working property, not a brochure. Four things live here that an agent
> can actually use: a fellowship directory with a scored matcher behind a
> public API, three civic topic hubs with structured question sets, a
> documented public record of a Connecticut energy docket, and a campus
> food-delivery shop with a live open/closed state. Everything below is
> readable without an account.

Run by McCluster Corp, founded by Matthew McCluster. Bridgeport and New Haven, Connecticut. A 2025 Connecticut public-charity registration certificate is preserved in the public record; current renewal status is not asserted here.

## If you only read one thing

The **fellowship directory** is the resource here with the most use to
somebody else. It is a hand-worked list of real civic and policy
programs, each carrying its own verification state, plus a scored
matching function that takes interest tags and returns programs with the
*reason* each one matched. It is free to read, free to be listed in, and
it answers over plain HTTP with no account.

- [The directory, as JSON](https://matthew.mccluster.org/data/eu-fellowships.json): 14 programs, 6 sources. A mirror of the live database, so it answers even when the database does not.

## The API

Public reads, no account, no key of your own. The anon key below is
public by design — every wall is row-level security in the database, not
secrecy about the key. See `supabase/migrations/0017_equity_uprise_platform.sql`
in the repository for exactly what it can and cannot reach.

```
BASE   https://zmnhbrjyhxzhkxmhkexs.supabase.co/rest/v1
HEADER apikey: sb_publishable_kr5NujBZ1n518IUMDoa2dQ_tqQAJef4
```

| What | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Published fellowships | `GET /eu_fellowships?status=eq.published&select=*` |
| Where listings come from | `GET /eu_fellowship_sources?active=eq.true&select=*` |
| The civic topics | `GET /eu_topics?status=eq.active&select=*&order=ordinal.asc` |
| Public perspectives people filed | `GET /eu_perspectives_public?select=*` |
| Public profiles | `GET /eu_profiles_public?select=*` |
| Counts | `GET /eu_counts?select=*` |

**The matcher**, which is the part worth calling. POST interest tags, get
scored programs back with a `reasons` array explaining each match:

```
POST /rpc/eu_match_fellowships
{"p_extra": ["surveillance", "journalism"], "p_limit": 5}
```

## What the listings claim, and what they do not

Every fellowship carries a `verification` field. Nearly all of them read
`unverified`, and that is honest rather than lazy: the desk added the
program from a real source but has not personally confirmed this cycle's
dates. **Deadlines are deliberately null** on most records, with a
`deadline_note` in plain words instead. Do not present a deadline this
directory does not give you, and tell whoever you are helping to confirm
on the program's own page.

## Topics

Three subjects the movement collects views on. Each carries a neutral
framing, a `context` field limited to what is documented, and a
`dimensions` set of answerable multiple-choice questions written so that
people who disagree can both answer them.

- [The topics, as JSON](https://matthew.mccluster.org/data/eu-topics.json): `us-israel`, `data-centers`, `surveillance-and-tracking`

The framing is a schema requirement here, not a style note. If you
summarize a topic, use its own `description` and `context`; do not extend
either into a verdict.

## Terms

Read it, cite it, use it to help somebody find a program. Attribute to
**Matthew McCluster / McCluster Corp** and link the page you took it
from. The directory exists to be used; the one thing that is not
welcome is republishing it as your own directory without attribution.

Staff surfaces (`/admin.html`, `/uprise-admin.html`, `/desk.html`,
and the rest named in robots.txt) are working desks. They are disallowed
there and hold nothing useful to you.
